subject: Short-term Subprocessor Addition: Edge Cache Shard & Data Egress Zones
messages:
From: EdgeCache Integration <integration@edgecache.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: Short-term shard deployment impacting EU cache egress

Hi Neha / Kimberly,

Quick heads-up: we are provisioning a temporary shard in our EU POP to reduce latency for a high-traffic Grad Dynamics rollout next week. The shard will be active for up to 30 days and will act as an ephemeral cache layer; it will occasionally fall back to our US origin for cold misses, which could result in cross-border egress for a subset of requests.

Attachments: edgecache-soc2-summary.pdf, dataflow-diagram-v2.png

Key points:
- Purpose: performance for Grad Dynamics EU users (trial period).
- Data stored: encrypted request/response blobs (TTL ~6 hours).
- Logs: aggregated telemetry (anonymized) sent to US analytics.
- Access to keys: managed by EdgeCache; key material never leaves HSMs.

We understand you may need DPA/DTA updates or evidence to proceed. Im attaching our SOC2 summary and a simplified dataflow. Happy to loop in our legal/DP contact if you want the DPA addendum now.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Integration Lead, EdgeCache Inc.

-----Original Message End-----

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: EdgeCache Integration <integration@edgecache.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Short-term shard deployment impacting EU cache egress

Samir — thanks for the quick notice and the attachments. A few ask items from our side before we greenlight anything into production:

1) Can you confirm whether the cache blobs contain any unredacted PII at rest? If yes, which fields?
2) Who holds the encryption keys and what is the key rotation cadence?
3) Where exactly will telemetry and logs egress (list of regions and destinations)?
4) We need a DPA addendum specifying the temporary shard and the EU->US transfer basis (std contractual clauses or other).

Looping in Jonas for technical verification and Kimberly for compliance/legal sign-off.

If you can provide the answers and an exportable dataflow (CSV of endpoints + regions) by EOD we can prioritize a 48-hour approval window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Samir / Neha — quick technical notes after reviewing the diagram:

- Cache contents: if those blobs include full request payloads, we should treat them as customer-controlled data. Please confirm whether payloads are redacted before caching.
- Encryption: if EdgeCache holds keys and theres no CSEK/CMK option, we will require strong contractual controls and a defined key compromise plan.
- Telemetry: please enumerate exact endpoints (hostname + IP ranges) where aggregated logs are forwarded (we need to run them against our egress allowlist).
- TTLs and purging: confirm purge API availability and proof of purging for the trial.

From an infra standpoint, a temporary onboarding is acceptable provided:
1) We get explicit confirmation that cache objects do not include unredacted PII or, if they do, that keys are customer-owned.
2) EdgeCache legal issues a DPA addendum with explicit EU->US transfer mechanism.
3) We have a method to revoke access and verify purge by API call.

Samir, can you respond inline and attach the endpoint CSV referenced by Neha? If youd like, we can run an automated egress scan against the hosts.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: EdgeCache Legal <legal@edgecache.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeCache Integration <integration@edgecache.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Short-term shard deployment impacting EU cache egress

Hi Jonas / Neha — thanks for the questions. Answers inline below and see attached redline DPA addendum.

- PII: Cache blobs do NOT intentionally contain unredacted PII. Were sending a sample payload and redaction rules in the CSV.
- Keys: EdgeCache currently manages keys in HSM (AWS KMS). We can support a BYOK flow for customers who request CMKs; requires a short onboarding (~2 business days).
- Telemetry endpoints: eu-pop01.edgecache.com (54.17.23.11), analytics-us.edgecache.com (3.115.88.20) — full CSV attached.
- Purge API: available and audit logs generated for purge calls; we can provide a signed purge response for verification.

Attachment: edgecache-dpa-addendum-redline.pdf, endpoints-eu-csv.csv

We are fine with the 30-day trial window and will accept the requirement for a DPA addendum. Please confirm whether Redwood needs BYOK for this trial or whether the documented mitigations (TTL, purge API, sample redaction rules) are sufficient.

Regards,
Laura Mendes
Senior Counsel, EdgeCache Inc.

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: EdgeCache Legal <legal@edgecache.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Short-term shard deployment impacting EU cache egress

Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the redline. Internal decision: we will provision the trial shard for the Grad Dynamics rollout under the following conditions:

1) EdgeCache provides the full endpoints CSV (received) and confirmation that sample payload redaction rules are in place (received).
2) For the trial period (<=30 days) we accept EdgeCache-managed keys provided you execute the attached DPA addendum; for production we will require BYOK/CMK.
3) EdgeCache must provide a purge API call log (signed response) within 24 hours of deprovisioning.
4) Any telemetry forwarded to US analytics must be limited to aggregated metrics; no raw request bodies to US.

Mina — please take the attached redline and produce a short DPA addendum that reflects the EU->US transfer mechanism (we prefer SCCs + documented safeguards) and a 90-day retention cap on caches unless explicitly approved. Loop in privacy if needed.

Samir/Laura — once Mina confirms the redline and you accept it, Neha and Jonas will validate the purge API and a small egress scan.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
